mechanics.title: Datapack tag
mechanics.description: Trim materials in the tag distractingtrims:distracts_piglins have the effect; only gold by default.

vanilla_changes.change: Armor pieces trimmed with the gold material count as gold armor for piglin neutrality; normal gold armor still works.

getting_started: Apply a gold trim to any armor piece at a smithing table and wear it in the Nether.
editor_notes: Recommended on both client and server.
name: Distracting Trims
summary: Armor with a gold trim keeps piglins from attacking you, just like gold armor pieces do.
